name: OpenRouter
tagline: One OpenAI-compatible gateway for many model providers.
shortDescription: OpenRouter routes requests across many model providers through an OpenAI-compatible API with visible model pricing.
agentSummary: Good for agents that need model fallback or broad model selection through one API, but provider variability needs monitoring.
bestFor: Model routing, fallback experiments, quick access to many providers, and cost comparison.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: Provider-specific reliability, data policy, and model versioning need review before sensitive workloads. Model behavior, costs, rate limits, data retention, and safety policies can change by model and account tier; use evals, spend caps, and data controls for sensitive workloads. API automation needs client-side throttling, idempotency where supported, pagination limits, retries, and audit logging. Store credentials outside source control and use least-privilege scopes, short-lived tokens, or restricted keys where the product supports them.
pricingSummary: Public model catalog with per-token prices and provider routing details.
authModel: API keys and optional app attribution headers.
browserSupport: Dashboard supports keys, credits, activity, and model selection.

capabilities.detail: OpenAI-compatible chat completions API supports many models.
Docs explain routing, headers, parameters, and provider behavior.
Model pages expose provider and per-token pricing.
Dashboard supports keys, credits, activity, and model selection.
